Ava Li: Quick heads-up — given infra delay, ask the product folks to re-evaluate MVP scope and suggest a 'lifeboat' cutlist we can ship in 4 weeks.
Jamal Ortiz: Ack. Can you confirm which infra blockers are blocking the most? CPU availability or model pinning?
Ava Li: CPU + cross-region model sync. Eng infra says we can get a hotspot in 3-4 weeks. If we need 2-week ship, we must cut candidate features.
Priya Nambisan: Let's split cuts into 'user-facing' and 'platform' buckets. User-facing first for metrics. Any customer commitments at risk?
Diego Ramos: ACME pilot wants tenant SSO and metrics. SSO is bigger. We can ship read-only metrics for MVP and defer SSO to v1.
Maya Chen: UX can compress flows: hide advanced settings behind 'beta' and remove onboarding animation to save time.
Jamal Ortiz: Proposed lifeboat cuts: 1) tenant SSO (v1), 2) onboarding animation, 3) advanced tenant routing UI, 4) scheduled exports (defer). Keep: core inference API, embeddings cache, basic telemetry.
Priya Nambisan: Customer communication: Priya will draft a note explaining timeline reset, offering ACME a rolling pilot with read-only metrics. ETA: EOD tomorrow.
Ava Li: Decision: move SSO to v1, deprioritize scheduled exports, push advanced routing. Confirmed MVP target: 4 weeks from today. Can we hit it if infra hotspot arrives in 3? Jamal?
Jamal Ortiz: If hotspot arrives in 3 weeks, yes with 1 week of hardening. We should also add a small regression test run per route to the QA plan.
Diego Ramos: I'll own the canary rollout plan and add automatic fallback to hosted model variant for first 48 hours.
Maya Chen: I'll prepare reduced onboarding flows and a tiny UI checklist for the cut. Need final list by tomorrow morning.
Priya Nambisan: Action items: Priya -> customer note; Jamal -> infra contingency runbook; Diego -> canary + rollback; Maya -> UI checklist; Ava -> update milestone tracker and call with sales.
LaunchBot: Reminder set — 'MVP lifeboat cutlist review' scheduled for 6am PT tomorrow.
Ava Li: Thanks team. Keep comments in this thread if anything else blocks the 4-week window. :thumbsup:
